cell.label: CSOM confirmed by tympanometry. Risk for hearing loss (craniofacial deformities, developmental delays)?
Audiometric evaluation (500, 1000, 2000, and 4000 Hz). Greater than 20 dB loss in any frequency?
21–39 dB is mild loss, 40 dB or more is moderate loss. Order comprehensive audiologic evaluation. Greater than 20 dB average pure-tone hearing loss?

Language testing and otolaryngolic referral. Consider tympanostomy tubes if chronic SOM >3 months or recurrent or persistent chronic SOM. Consider adenoidectomy if nasal obstruction or chronic adenoiditis.
Optimize learning environment. Repeat audiometry in 3-6 months if chronic SOM persists.
